Complete Guide to Case Converter

Accidentally typing with Caps Lock on or converting database column names into camelCase variables shouldn't require manual retyping. TECHTIS Case Converter lets you transform large blocks of text into nine standard casing formats with a single click.

Our transformation library includes standard writing cases (Sentence case, Title Case, UPPERCASE, lowercase) as well as developer naming conventions (camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, and kebab-case) and novelty Alternating Case. Intelligent Title Casing ensures that minor prepositions and conjunctions remain properly formatted.

All casing conversions run locally on your device CPU, ensuring your sensitive notes, passwords, and source code remain completely confidential.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Case Converter and privacy

How to convert text case online (sentence case, uppercase, lowercase, title case) for free?
Paste your text into TECHTIS Case Converter. Click any transformation button - Sentence case, lower case, UPPER CASE, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, or CONSTANT_CASE. Copy your converted text in one click.
How does Sentence Case work?
It automatically capitalizes the first letter of each sentence, following periods, question marks, and exclamation marks, while converting the rest to lowercase.
Are my confidential documents or code snippets uploaded to any server?
No! All string transformations execute strictly inside your local browser memory. Zero text leaves your device.
Can I convert text into programmer identifier styles like camelCase?
Yes! Full developer support includes camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, and SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.
Does Title Case handle small words like 'and', 'the', 'in' correctly?
Yes. Our intelligent Title Case algorithm keeps minor conjunctions and prepositions lowercase unless they are the first word of the headline.
Does this tool work on mobile phones?
Yes, you can paste and convert text smoothly on iOS Safari and Android Chrome.
Does TECHTIS charge for converting large documents?
No. TECHTIS is 100% free with unlimited text conversions.
Does this tool work completely offline?
Yes! Once loaded in your browser cache, the tool functions without an internet connection.
